name: Evolution API
description: Evolution API is an open-source WhatsApp integration API. Connect WhatsApp numbers as instances through WhatsApp Web (Baileys) or the official Cloud API, then send and receive messages over a REST API and webhooks, with built-in bridges to Chatwoot, Typebot, n8n, Dify, Flowise and OpenAI and a web manager.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:8080/manager and sign in with the server URL and the global API key (AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY in /opt/evolution-api_data/.env).
WhatsApp Web instances use an unofficial protocol; WhatsApp can ban numbers used for bulk or automated messaging.

app_vars.name: var_server_url
app_vars.label: Public Server URL
app_vars.help: Defaults to http://<container IP>:8080; set it when the API sits behind a reverse proxy
